items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-28
items.q: I knew him from the audience.

ctx.x: I wonder where he was from? Was he from Birmingham or something? Or did he just have that foundation?

Well in fact, I couldn't exactly tell you, Wyman Ham's home, but I knew him from the audience. He might not have had a home. Because he was one of dopey, he used to use hop and things. He meant black people. Black people.

One thing I was wondering about, where do breaks come from? Where does the idea of a break come from? You know, like a two-ball break? All the rhythm stops and this time, you know, you seem to have a little break in them.
